Protocol.ReferenceDerivation: Preserve nominal139 rear curve at m147kg,Iw0.9kgm2,R0.33m,mu1.2845000267028808. Freeze BOTH material velocity floors once; never depend on a run's Iw, mass, dt or solver tolerance. Not a fitted speed/lap target.

Equations.Solver: g(z)=z+c*z/sqrt(d2+z2)-abs(S)=0; gprime>=1; bracket[0,abs(S)]; implicit midpoint wheel/longitudinal body, original explicit planar hold
Equations.Front: Unchanged139; no Iw/dt in held-angle constitutive query; .03 lateral slope floor is not temporal relaxation

MathematicalGates.Convergence: last adjacent scaled-state error < first adjacent error, or first below1e-5 roundoff floor; all four h and physical0.2s endpoints retained; no h-dependent material parameters

NativeModes.Long: Exactly139 B: one .2s causal early preparation, .6s requested full pulse near exit, then134A
NativeModes.Short: Exactly139 C: same preparation and first full request;134A resumes both channels at next .2s review

Protocol.NativePolicy: #16015 frozen134A weights, action set, H09 and utility; only prediction/contact equations use new material when enabled. Original .24s reaction, .2s reviews, +/-35deg and90deg/s remain.
Protocol.NativeGates: All inherited track, reverse, energy, actuator and beta45 guards literal. Old two-bend+1s and full next62m gates separate. Max energy ledger residual <=.05J+1e-6*bodyK; actual yaw update error<=2e-5rad/s; no speed acceptance criterion.
Protocol.Allocation: 12 planned worlds: original/new0.5s D0 preflight +8 new D0,D1,H0,H1 long/short +2 new D0 short perturbations (+/-.25deg heading,+/-.01rad/s yaw) from initial start. Eight old139 B/C outcomes reused, not rerun.
Protocol.Confirmation: H0/H1 withheld within140 until diagnostic lock. Families were used in139, so not a newly unseen empirical dataset. No tuning on these cases.
Protocol.Ordering: Freeze; mathematics; exact OFF-prefix/new preflight; diagnostic D0/D1 and perturbations; separate frozen confirmation lock; H0/H1; final standard Windows CI.

Front.Meaning: Held actual steering equals request. A moving steering actuator can physically change the within-step axes with dt. Front original mass/capacity slope floor remains phenomenological; no temporal force memory or Iw.

Convergence.Meaning: Same 0.2s endpoint, same parameters for all h. Expected first-order planar held-force coupling; finest h is not an exact solution. Reports all force, omega, slip, torque and energy diagnostics.

Perturbation.Meaning: Local perturbed ODE diagnostic from an already failed historical state, not a legal native reset or proof of a drift equilibrium. Native perturbations start before both bends.
